submission.summary:
Reconciled outpatient med lists for the 5 patients discharged from Valley General since 9/17, incorporating post-discharge PCP/specialist updates and completed antibiotic/analgesic courses.

pt-1006 (NSTEMI/DES 9/22): metoprolol succinate ER increased 25→50 mg daily; added pantoprazole 40 mg daily for GI protection on DAPT; added ticagrelor 90 mg BID (cardiology 9/29 stopped clopidogrel for CYP2C19 poor metabolizer status — clopidogrel never added to list). Lisinopril not added (stopped by Dr. Okafor 9/25 for hypotension/lightheadedness). Aspirin, atorvastatin, metformin unchanged.

pt-1009 (lap chole 9/21): added acetaminophen 1000 mg PRN (max 3 g/day); ferritin 12 (<30) so started ferrous sulfate 325 mg daily per discharge instructions. Ibuprofen course ended 9/25, not added.

pt-1011 (status migrainosus 9/28): added topiramate 25 mg at bedtime (continued per Dr. Shah 9/30 despite paresthesias) and ondansetron 4 mg PRN; sumatriptan 50 mg PRN continued. IV inpatient meds not continued.

pt-1012 (hypertensive urgency 9/28): stopped lisinopril (ACE cough) and HCTZ (hyponatremia); stopped metoprolol tartrate and started metoprolol succinate ER 50 mg daily; added losartan at 100 mg daily (discharge 50 mg, increased 9/30 for BP 148-156/88-94); metformin increased to 1000 mg BID; empagliflozin 10 mg daily added (started 10/1 after copay assistance). Omeprazole retained (inpatient pantoprazole was formulary substitution only). Cefpodoxime course completed 9/30, not added.

pt-1025 (cellulitis/AKI 9/23): 9/29 creatinine 1.34 (>1.2 threshold), so lisinopril remains held and was discontinued from the active list with note for Dr. Shah to reassess at the 10/7 visit. Metformin and rosuvastatin resumed/unchanged; cephalexin course completed 9/29, not added.

pt-1012 (hypertensive urgency, d/c 9/28): lisinopril discontinued (ACEI cough) and losartan started — entered at 100 mg daily per Dr. Okafor's 9/30 increase; HCTZ discontinued (hyponatremia, not to restart); metoprolol tartrate 25 mg BID discontinued and metoprolol succinate ER 50 mg daily started; metformin increased to 1000 mg BID; empagliflozin 10 mg daily added (started today 10/1 after copay assistance). Omeprazole 20 mg kept (hospital pantoprazole was a formulary substitution only); aspirin and atorvastatin continued. Cefpodoxime not added — course completed 9/30.

pt-1025 (cellulitis with AKI, d/c 9/23): lisinopril discontinued/held — 9/29 creatinine 1.34 exceeds the 1.2 threshold for restarting, PCP to reassess 10/7. Metformin and rosuvastatin resumed/continued; cephalexin course completed 9/29 so not added.

Patients discharged before 9/17 (pt-1008, pt-1029) were not touched.
